description: Three low-frequency oscillators in one panel, each giving a sine, a triangle, a saw and a square at once

params.text: UNI lifts that oscillator's four waves to 0V to 10V; BI leaves them at -5V to +5V
180 degrees turns that oscillator's four waves upside down; 0 degrees leaves them alone
Sets the rate of that oscillator, from one cycle in four minutes up to 1kHz

inputs.text: A trigger here restarts that oscillator from the beginning of its cycle

outputs.text: The sine wave from that oscillator
The triangle wave from that oscillator
The saw wave from that oscillator
The square wave from that oscillator

inputs.0: high above 1V · stepped · one channel only
inputs.1: high above 1V · stepped · one channel only
inputs.2: high above 1V · stepped · one channel only
